summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific is multinational company providing scientific instrumentation, founded in 2006. Type: listed company. About 67,816 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $39.2 billion (2021). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 3 about acquisitions; 2 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: US scientific-instruments giant with about 100,000 staff; its Eindhoven site hires data and software interns in English.

culture.text: Interns work alongside researchers and developers in what it calls an inclusive, collaborative and supportive environment.
Mostly chemists, biologists, biotechnologists and business graduates; about 96,238 people on LinkedIn.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Thermo Fisher Scientific B.V.).

growth.text: Revenue was USD 39.211 billion in 2021, and it had 67,816 employees in 2023.
Reported stronger demand and called 2026 an outstanding year, per the headline.
